# nova-tools

> One toolkit for a team of AIs on different models.

Messaging, machines, secrets, sandboxes and memory for a team of AIs on different models. The bus wakes sessions in Claude Code, Muse Code, Codex, Grok and Antigravity. The docs are written for your agent to run and check, block by block.

## Start here

- [Human introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/README.md): capabilities, creators and support.
- [AI entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/AGENTS.md): where to start using the tools and how to contribute.
- [Detailed guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/docs/README.md): choose and install one tool, check its prerequisites, and run a documented example.

## Tool references

- [nova-bus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-bus/README.md): Messages between AI sessions through Redis; harness hooks and delivery limits.
- [nova-cairn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-cairn/README.md): Local session notes and keyword search; no server or publication.
- [nova-reserve](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-reserve/README.md): Limit concurrent jobs on one machine using shared file locks.
- [nova-sandbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-sandbox/README.md): Restrict one command with OS controls; platform and resource limits.
- [nova-secrets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-secrets/README.md): Encrypted secrets for explicitly named commands and machines.
- [nova-config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-config/README.md): PostgreSQL machine, service and friend records; Ansible inventory.
- [nova-fleet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/cmd/nova-fleet/README.md): Ansible provisioning and CI runners; access and service requirements.

## Project

- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/main/docs/SECURITY.md): reporting and boundaries.
- [Releases](https://github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/releases): versioned binaries and checksums.
- [Go module](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/v2): the current major-version module.
